confidence_rule: High confidence requires assessable required features and no major unresolved contradiction.

patterns.label: Sinus rhythm
required_or_defining_evidence: Consistent sinus P-wave morphology
Each sinus P is followed by QRS
Stable AV relationship
patterns.diagnostic_boundary: Pattern label only; rate determines brady/tachy modifiers.

patterns.label: Sinus bradycardia
required_or_defining_evidence: Sinus rhythm mechanics
Ventricular rate below expected adult resting range
patterns.diagnostic_boundary: ECG rate label does not establish hemodynamic significance.

patterns.label: Sinus tachycardia
required_or_defining_evidence: Sinus rhythm mechanics
Elevated ventricular rate
patterns.diagnostic_boundary: Etiology cannot be determined from ECG alone.

patterns.label: Sinus arrhythmia
required_or_defining_evidence: Sinus P morphology preserved
Cyclic RR variability
patterns.diagnostic_boundary: Clinical significance depends on context.

patterns.label: Premature atrial complex pattern
required_or_defining_evidence: Premature atrial depolarization with altered P morphology
Usually narrow conducted QRS unless aberrant/block
patterns.diagnostic_boundary: Do not infer burden from a short sample.

patterns.label: Premature ventricular complex pattern
required_or_defining_evidence: Premature wide QRS not preceded by a clearly conducting sinus P
Abnormal ventricular morphology
patterns.diagnostic_boundary: Morphology alone does not establish structural disease.

patterns.label: Atrial fibrillation pattern
required_or_defining_evidence: Irregularly irregular ventricular response when AV conduction is variable
No consistent organized sinus P waves
patterns.diagnostic_boundary: A noisy irregular strip is not sufficient if atrial activity cannot be assessed.

patterns.label: Atrial flutter pattern
required_or_defining_evidence: Organized repetitive atrial activity
Atrial activity not sinus P morphology
patterns.diagnostic_boundary: Mechanism/context may require longer tracing.

patterns.label: Multifocal atrial tachycardia pattern
required_or_defining_evidence: Irregular rhythm
At least three distinct P-wave morphologies when clearly visible
Variable PR intervals
Tachycardic rate
patterns.diagnostic_boundary: Only use when P-wave morphology is actually discernible.

patterns.label: Junctional rhythm pattern
required_or_defining_evidence: Narrow QRS rhythm unless aberrancy
Sinus P waves absent before QRS or retrograde/closely related P waves
patterns.diagnostic_boundary: Etiology and AV-node level require context.

patterns.label: Regular narrow-complex tachycardia
required_or_defining_evidence: Regular tachycardia
Narrow QRS unless rate-related aberrancy
supportive_evidence: P waves may be hidden or retrograde
patterns.diagnostic_boundary: Do not force AVNRT vs AVRT vs atrial tachycardia without evidence.

patterns.label: First-degree AV delay
required_or_defining_evidence: 1:1 AV conduction
PR >200 ms when accurately measurable
patterns.diagnostic_boundary: Guideline terminology recognizes this as AV delay rather than true block.

patterns.label: Second-degree AV block, Mobitz I pattern
required_or_defining_evidence: Intermittent nonconducted P wave
Inconstant/progressive PR behavior surrounding the dropped beat
patterns.diagnostic_boundary: Describe the PR sequence, not just the name.

patterns.label: Second-degree AV block, Mobitz II pattern
required_or_defining_evidence: Intermittent nonconducted P wave
Constant PR intervals in conducted beats
Pattern is not pure 2:1
patterns.diagnostic_boundary: Use only when constant conducted PR intervals are demonstrable.

patterns.label: 2:1 AV block
required_or_defining_evidence: Every other P wave conducts to QRS
patterns.diagnostic_boundary: Do not classify as Mobitz I or II from 2:1 pattern alone.

patterns.label: High-grade AV block pattern
required_or_defining_evidence: At least two consecutive P waves fail to conduct
Some AV conduction remains
patterns.diagnostic_boundary: Urgency depends on rate, escape, symptoms, and context.

patterns.label: Third-degree/complete AV block pattern
required_or_defining_evidence: No evidence of AV conduction
Atrial and ventricular activity dissociated
patterns.diagnostic_boundary: Confirm independent atrial and ventricular activity.

patterns.label: Complete right bundle branch block pattern
required_or_defining_evidence: QRS >=120 ms in adult
Compatible terminal rightward morphology in V1/V2
Broad/delayed terminal S in lateral leads
patterns.diagnostic_boundary: Duration alone is insufficient.

patterns.label: Incomplete right bundle branch block pattern
required_or_defining_evidence: QRS 110-119 ms in adult
Compatible RBBB morphology
patterns.diagnostic_boundary: Use morphology + duration.

patterns.label: Complete left bundle branch block pattern
required_or_defining_evidence: QRS >=120 ms in adult
Broad/notched/slurred lateral R-wave morphology
Expected LBBB precordial/lateral morphology
patterns.diagnostic_boundary: Duration alone is insufficient; ischemia evaluation needs LBBB-aware criteria.

patterns.label: Nonspecific intraventricular conduction delay
required_or_defining_evidence: QRS prolonged
Does not satisfy complete RBBB/LBBB morphology
patterns.diagnostic_boundary: Descriptive diagnosis, not etiology.

patterns.label: Left anterior fascicular block pattern
required_or_defining_evidence: Left/superior frontal axis compatible with LAFB
Supporting limb-lead morphology
patterns.diagnostic_boundary: Do not diagnose from axis alone.

patterns.label: Left posterior fascicular block pattern
required_or_defining_evidence: Rightward frontal axis compatible with LPFB
Supporting limb-lead morphology
More common alternative causes of right-axis deviation excluded
patterns.diagnostic_boundary: Diagnosis of exclusion; uncommon.

patterns.label: Ventricular pre-excitation pattern
required_or_defining_evidence: Shortened AV conduction/PR when measurable
Delta-wave/slurred initial QRS upstroke
Widened/fused QRS morphology
patterns.diagnostic_boundary: Pattern does not alone determine accessory-pathway risk.

patterns.label: Atrial paced rhythm
required_or_defining_evidence: Atrial pacing spikes preceding atrial depolarization when visible
Subsequent AV conduction as present
patterns.diagnostic_boundary: Do not infer device mode/programming.

patterns.label: Ventricular paced rhythm
required_or_defining_evidence: Ventricular pacing spike preceding paced QRS when visible
Wide paced QRS morphology
patterns.diagnostic_boundary: Do not infer device mode/programming.

patterns.label: Possible pacing failure to capture
required_or_defining_evidence: Pacing stimulus visible without expected subsequent depolarization on repeated cycles
patterns.diagnostic_boundary: Requires prompt device/clinical correlation; ECG does not establish cause.

patterns.label: Possible pacemaker undersensing pattern
required_or_defining_evidence: Pacing stimuli occur despite intrinsic depolarizations when timing clearly supports inappropriate sensing behavior
patterns.diagnostic_boundary: Do not infer programming cause.

patterns.label: Accelerated idioventricular rhythm pattern
required_or_defining_evidence: Ventricular-origin wide QRS rhythm
Rate faster than ventricular escape but not necessarily tachycardic
patterns.diagnostic_boundary: Rate/context matter; avoid arbitrary mechanism certainty from short strip.

patterns.label: Regular monomorphic wide-complex tachycardia
required_or_defining_evidence: Regular tachycardia
Wide QRS
Stable QRS morphology
supportive_evidence: AV dissociation/capture/fusion if visible support VT
patterns.diagnostic_boundary: When uncertain, call WCT and keep VT a major consideration.

patterns.label: Polymorphic ventricular tachycardia pattern
required_or_defining_evidence: Rapid wide-complex tachycardia with beat-to-beat QRS morphology/axis variation
patterns.diagnostic_boundary: Do not call torsades unless twisting morphology/QT context supports it.

patterns.label: Torsades de pointes pattern
required_or_defining_evidence: Polymorphic VT with waxing/waning twisting QRS axis around baseline
patterns.diagnostic_boundary: Torsades is a rhythm phenotype; cause still requires context.

patterns.label: Ventricular fibrillation pattern
required_or_defining_evidence: Chaotic ventricular electrical activity without organized QRS complexes
patterns.diagnostic_boundary: Confirm not artifact whenever possible.

patterns.label: Left-axis deviation
required_or_defining_evidence: Frontal QRS axis < -30 degrees when measured or quadrant evidence supports
patterns.diagnostic_boundary: Axis is descriptive; cause requires context.

patterns.label: Right-axis deviation
required_or_defining_evidence: Frontal QRS axis > +90 degrees when measured or quadrant evidence supports
major_confounders_or_mimics: Normal variant depending on age/body habitus
patterns.diagnostic_boundary: Adult default only.

patterns.label: LVH voltage pattern
required_or_defining_evidence: One or more validated voltage criteria are met when gain/lead quality are known
patterns.diagnostic_boundary: ECG voltage has limited sensitivity/specificity; do not equate with anatomic LVH.

patterns.label: LVH-type secondary repolarization pattern
required_or_defining_evidence: High-voltage/LVH context
Discordant ST depression/T-wave inversion pattern consistent with secondary repolarization
patterns.diagnostic_boundary: Can confound ischemia interpretation; do not dismiss dynamic/concordant changes.

patterns.label: Right-heart strain pattern
required_or_defining_evidence: Rightward/right-precordial pattern compatible with RV pressure/strain
Anterior/inferior T-wave changes may be present
patterns.diagnostic_boundary: ECG cannot diagnose pulmonary embolism.

patterns.label: Low QRS voltage pattern
required_or_defining_evidence: Low QRS amplitudes by accepted limb/precordial voltage criteria when gain is confirmed
patterns.diagnostic_boundary: Etiology cannot be assigned from ECG alone.

patterns.label: Electrical alternans pattern
required_or_defining_evidence: Beat-to-beat alternation in QRS amplitude/axis beyond obvious artifact
patterns.diagnostic_boundary: Does not by itself diagnose tamponade.

patterns.label: Prolonged QT/QTc pattern
required_or_defining_evidence: QT/QTc exceeds applicable reference threshold with reliable measurement
patterns.diagnostic_boundary: A prolonged QTc is not synonymous with congenital LQTS.

patterns.label: Short QT pattern
required_or_defining_evidence: QT/QTc appears abnormally short with reliable measurement
patterns.diagnostic_boundary: Do not diagnose short-QT syndrome from one tracing.

patterns.label: Type-1 Brugada ECG pattern
required_or_defining_evidence: Type-1 coved right-precordial ST morphology
J-point elevation >=0.2 mV when calibrated
T-wave inversion in V1/V2 in standard or high right-precordial position
patterns.diagnostic_boundary: ECG pattern is not by itself Brugada syndrome.

patterns.label: Early repolarization pattern
required_or_defining_evidence: J-point elevation/notching/slurring in compatible leads
Pattern otherwise consistent with early repolarization
patterns.diagnostic_boundary: Pattern and syndrome/risk are not equivalent.

patterns.label: Conventional ST-elevation threshold pattern
required_or_defining_evidence: New ST elevation at J point in >=2 contiguous leads meeting sex/age/lead thresholds when calibration and context permit
patterns.diagnostic_boundary: Threshold status is not the same as final MI diagnosis.

patterns.label: Ischemic ST-depression pattern
required_or_defining_evidence: New horizontal/downsloping ST depression >=0.5 mm at J point in >=2 contiguous leads when calibrated
patterns.diagnostic_boundary: ECG finding requires clinical context.

patterns.label: Hyperacute T-wave pattern
required_or_defining_evidence: Broad symmetric T waves disproportionately large to preceding QRS in contiguous leads
patterns.diagnostic_boundary: Can be an early occlusion pattern without classic ST-elevation thresholds.

patterns.label: de Winter pattern
required_or_defining_evidence: Prominent symmetric precordial T waves
Upsloping ST depression in precordial leads
patterns.diagnostic_boundary: Treat as occlusion-pattern concern, not a final MI diagnosis.

patterns.label: Wellens-type anterior T-wave pattern
required_or_defining_evidence: Biphasic or deeply inverted T waves in V2-V3 with compatible morphology
supportive_evidence: Extension to neighboring precordial leads may occur
patterns.diagnostic_boundary: Syndrome-level interpretation requires appropriate clinical context.

patterns.label: Posterior ischemia/occlusion pattern
required_or_defining_evidence: ST depression in V1-V3 compatible with reciprocal posterior injury
Dominant anterior R waves may support
supportive_evidence: Posterior leads V7-V9 can add evidence
patterns.diagnostic_boundary: Not proven without clinical integration; posterior leads may help.

patterns.label: Sgarbossa-type ischemia/occlusion concern
required_or_defining_evidence: LBBB or ventricular paced QRS context
Concordant or excessively discordant ST deviation compatible with Sgarbossa/modified framework
patterns.diagnostic_boundary: Use a validated Sgarbossa framework; do not apply ordinary ST thresholds naively.

patterns.label: Diffuse subendocardial ischemia pattern
required_or_defining_evidence: Widespread ST depression with a distribution compatible with subendocardial ischemia
supportive_evidence: ST elevation in aVR may coexist
patterns.diagnostic_boundary: Do not infer a specific coronary anatomy from aVR alone.

patterns.label: Pathologic Q-wave pattern
required_or_defining_evidence: Q waves meeting applicable duration/depth criteria in contiguous leads when measurable
patterns.diagnostic_boundary: Does not alone prove prior MI.

patterns.label: Pericarditis-like ECG pattern
required_or_defining_evidence: Widespread ST elevation and/or PR depression with compatible distribution
supportive_evidence: Reciprocal PR elevation in aVR may support
patterns.diagnostic_boundary: Acute pericarditis is a clinical diagnosis requiring additional criteria.

patterns.label: Hyperkalemia-like ECG pattern
required_or_defining_evidence: Repolarization/conduction morphology compatible with potassium excess
supportive_evidence: May include peaked T waves, PR/QRS changes in more advanced patterns
patterns.diagnostic_boundary: Never diagnose or estimate potassium concentration from ECG alone.

patterns.label: Hypokalemia-like ECG pattern
required_or_defining_evidence: ST depression/T-wave flattening and prominent U-wave/T-U changes compatible with potassium depletion
patterns.diagnostic_boundary: Correlate with measured electrolytes.

patterns.label: Hypocalcemia-like prolonged repolarization pattern
required_or_defining_evidence: QT prolongation predominantly via ST-segment lengthening may be compatible
patterns.diagnostic_boundary: Correlate with measured calcium and context.

patterns.label: Hypercalcemia-like short repolarization pattern
required_or_defining_evidence: Short QT/ST segment morphology may be compatible
patterns.diagnostic_boundary: Correlate with measured calcium and context.

patterns.label: Hypothermia-like J-wave pattern
required_or_defining_evidence: Prominent J/Osborn-type waves in compatible context
patterns.diagnostic_boundary: Temperature/context required; ECG alone does not diagnose hypothermia.

source_traceability_rule: Every active pattern must reference at least one authoritative source key; disease/syndrome labels remain bounded by diagnostic_boundary.
